comments.story: Ask HN: What is your favorite YouTube channel for developers?
comments.text: [LINK] is by far my favorite and I've spent many hours watching him. He does things like create a Doom-style engine from scratch: [VIDEO] .. create a NES emulator: [LINK] .. work back from a C++17 example to show why new C++ standards are needed: [LINK] .. and even building a Tetris clone in GW-BASIC: [LINK] .. Right now, he's doing a series on cracking 80s videogame passwords: [LINK] Sirajology - [LINK] - is another interesting one. He moves a bit too quickly for me, but does things like explain machine learning in 5 minutes or how to generate music with systems like Tensorflow.
